description.p: Stroke. You surge forward, dragging a line of force through your movement.
Before moving, choose a straight line up to a distance equal to your remaining movement. Each creature whose space the line passes through must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failed save, a creature takes 1d4 + your Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type and is pushed 5 feet directly away from the line.
On a successful save, the creature takes no damage.

description.p: This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from creatures affected by this Study.

sheet.description: Move in a straight line. Creatures whose spaces the line passes through make a Dexterity save or take 1d4 + Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type and are pushed 5 feet away from the line. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from affected creatures.

description.p: Shade. You mark a point you can see within 30 feet, causing a burst of pigment to bloom outward.
Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failed save, a creature takes 1d4 + your Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type.
On a successful save, the creature takes no damage.

description.p: The sphere disperses immediately after the effect resolves.

sheet.description: Choose a point within 30 feet. Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Dexterity save or take 1d4 + Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type.

description.p: Fan. You release a sweeping arc of color in a controlled burst.
Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 + your Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type and has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
On a successful save, the creature takes no damage.

sheet.description: Creatures in a 15-foot cone make a Dexterity save or take 1d6 + Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type and have their speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

description.p: Smear. You drag unstable pigment across the ground in a disruptive sweep.
Choose a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failed save, a creature takes 1d4 + your Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type, and the ground in the line becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
On a successful save, the creature takes no damage.

sheet.description: Choose a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Creatures in the line make a Dexterity save or take 1d4 + Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type. The ground in the line becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

description.p: Scatter. You snap pigment outward in a tight, unstable burst.
Each creature of your choice within 5 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw.

ul.li: On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 + your Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type and is pushed 5 feet away from you.
On a successful save, the creature takes no damage.

sheet.description: Creatures of your choice within 5 feet of you make a Dexterity save or take 1d6 + Wisdom modifier damage of your current Palette’s type and are pushed 5 feet away from you.

description.p: Contour Guard. You reinforce your outline with controlled expression.
Until the start of your next turn, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier.
In addition, the first time a creature hits you with an attack before the effect ends, that creature takes 1d4 damage of your current Palette’s type.
Once this damage is dealt, the effect ends early.

sheet.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier until the start of your next turn. The first creature that hits you before then takes 1d4 damage of your current Palette’s type, and the effect ends.
